# Lensfun database

The XML files under db/ are the lens calibration database of the
Lensfun project (https://lensfun.github.io/), snapshot of commit
1c8b8f078aae (2026-08-14) from https://github.com/lensfun/lensfun,
data/db.

License: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0 (CC-BY-SA 3.0),
as stated by the Lensfun project's README. This is a DATA license
covering the database files themselves: Heeler bundles them unmodified
with this attribution, and any modification Heeler ever makes to these
files will be published under the same license. The Lensfun LIBRARY
(LGPL-3 C code) is not used or linked; Heeler reads these files with
its own parser.
